changeSet.author: Fiter
changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_prequalification_group g INNER JOIN ( SELECT ranked.group_id, ranked.agency_id FROM ( SELECT mpgm.group_id, ma.id AS agency_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY mpgm.group_id ORDER BY LENGTH(agencyOffice.hierarchy) DESC, ma.id ) AS rn FROM m_prequalification_group_members mpgm INNER JOIN m_client mc ON mc.dpi = mpgm.dpi INNER JOIN m_office clientOffice ON clientOffice.id = mc.office_id INNER JOIN m_agency ma ON ma.linked_office_id IS NOT NULL INNER JOIN m_office agencyOffice ON agencyOffice.id = ma.linked_office_id WHERE clientOffice.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(agencyOffice.hierarchy, '%') OR agencyOffice.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(clientOffice.hierarchy, '%') ) ranked WHERE ranked.rn = 1 ) memberAgency ON memberAgency.group_id = g.id SET g.agency_id = memberAgency.agency_id WHERE g.prequalification_type_enum = 1;
